error_unreachable: The server could not be reached, so nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.
login_description: Use the account your school gave you.
auth_email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your email before signing in.
auth_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
auth_no_profile: This account has not been set up yet. Ask your administrator.
admin_home_description: Set up tuition centers under Organizations, and what their students practise under Practice.
classroom_unknown_staff: That classroom is not one of yours.
classroom_unknown_student: That class is not one of yours.
picker_empty_staff: You have not been assigned to a classroom yet.
picker_empty_student: You have not joined a class yet.
classrooms_empty_description: Add the first classroom to group teachers and students.
classrooms_no_match: No classrooms match. Try a different search.
classrooms_delete_description: Its teacher and student lists and all the practice recorded in it are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
classrooms_archived: {name} is archived. Its teachers and students no longer see it.
classroom_archived_note: Archived. Only managers see this classroom, and nothing in it can be changed until it is restored.
form_create_description: A classroom groups teachers and students around one grade and subject.
form_edit_description: Change the grade, subject or name of this classroom.
form_name_required: Enter a name for the classroom.
form_name_too_long: A name can be up to 120 characters long.
form_cover_invalid: The cover must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image of 4 MB or less.
members_description: Any teacher or student in your organization can be added to this classroom, and each may belong to several classrooms.
members_no_students: No students in this classroom yet.
members_no_teachers: No teachers in this classroom yet.
members_no_students_found: No students match. Try a different search.
members_no_teachers_found: No teachers match. Try a different search.
members_no_managers_found: No managers match. Try a different search.
people_no_students_description: Add the first student, then put them in a classroom.
people_no_teachers_description: Add the first teacher, then put them in a classroom.
people_no_managers_description: Add the first manager. They set up the organization's teachers, students and classrooms.
person_student_description: A student signs in with the username and password you set here.
person_teacher_description: A teacher signs in with this email and the password you set here.
person_manager_description: A manager signs in with this email and the password you set here.
person_name_too_long: A name can be up to 100 characters long.
person_username_invalid: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
person_username_taken: That username is already in use.
person_email_taken: An account with that email already exists.
person_password_hint: Pass it on to them yourself. It is not shown again.
person_password_invalid: A password must be 8 to 72 characters long.
password_reset_description: {name} signs in with the new password from now on. The old one stops working.
organizations_none_found: No organizations match. Try a different search.
organizations_none_description: Create the first organization, then add its manager.
organization_new_description: An organization is one tuition center. Its managers are added once it is created.
organization_name_required: Enter a name for the organization.
organization_name_too_long: A name can be up to 120 characters long.
organization_name_taken: An organization with that name already exists.
organization_rename_description: Everything in the organization stays as it is. Only its name changes.
organization_delete_description: The organization and everything in it is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
organization_delete_accounts: {managers}, {teachers} and {students}, with their accounts. None of them can sign in again.
organization_delete_classrooms: {classrooms}, with every assignment and all the practice recorded there.
organization_delete_confirm: Type the organization's name to confirm
organization_delete_mismatch: That is not the organization's name. Nothing was deleted.
curriculum_empty_description: Add the first grade level below to start the curriculum.
row_name_invalid: A name must be 1 to 120 characters long.
row_name_taken: That name is already used here.
image_invalid: The picture must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image of 4 MB or less.
curriculum_delete_grade: Its subjects and topics are deleted with it, along with their stages, practice questions and practice records. This cannot be undone. A grade level that a classroom uses cannot be deleted.
curriculum_delete_subject: Its topics are deleted with it, along with their stages, practice questions and practice records. This cannot be undone. A subject that a classroom uses cannot be deleted.
curriculum_delete_topic: Its stages are deleted with it, along with their practice questions and practice records. This cannot be undone.
curriculum_in_use: It cannot be deleted while a classroom uses it.
practice_empty_description: Add grade levels and their subjects in Curriculum first.
practice_no_topics_description: Add this subject’s topics in Curriculum first. Stages are added to a topic.
practice_delete_stage: Its questions and passages are deleted with it, along with their pictures and pupils’ practice records. This cannot be undone.

match.countPlural=one: {count} question. Pupils answer all of them, in this order.
match.countPlural=other: {count} questions. Pupils answer all of them, in this order.

match.countPlural=one: {count} question. Pupils answer all of them, in a random order.
match.countPlural=other: {count} questions. Pupils answer all of them, in a random order.

practice_no_match: No questions match. Try a different search.
practice_stage_empty_description: Choose a type under Add Question to write the first one.
practice_delete_question_description: Its pictures and pupils’ progress on it are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
practice_tip_hint: Shown in the result to a pupil who gets this wrong. The right answer is never shown.
practice_fix_to_save: Fix what is marked, then save.
practice_leave_description: This question has changes that have not been saved.
practice_mcq_hint: Mark the one right answer. A wrong option can carry a tip, shown to a pupil who picks it.
practice_mrq_hint: Mark every right answer. A wrong option can carry a tip, shown to a pupil who picks it.
practice_option_tip_placeholder: Tip for a pupil who picks this
practice_short_answer_hint: Capital letters and spaces at either end are ignored.
practice_passage_blurb: A text or a picture, with the questions that go with it.
practice_passage_content_hint: A passage can be a text, a picture, or both.
practice_passage_questions_hint: Any type. Pupils get them one after another, in this order, with the passage beside each.
practice_passage_save_first: Save the passage to add questions to it.
practice_passage_marking: Each question is marked on its own. The passage and its questions stay together as one block, in fixed and in random order.

match.countPlural=one: Followed by its question. The passage stays in view for it.
match.countPlural=other: Followed by its {count} questions, one at a time. The passage stays in view for each.

practice_passage_content_required: Write the passage’s text, or add a picture.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} question is deleted with it, along with its pictures and pupils’ progress on it. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} questions are deleted with it, along with their pictures and pupils’ progress. This cannot be undone.

practice_delete_passage_empty: It has no questions. This cannot be undone.
practice_leave_passage_description: This passage has changes that have not been saved.
practice_learning_points_none: Learning points are set for each topic, and this topic has none yet.
practice_learning_points_not_saved: The question was saved, but its learning points were not. Try again.
item_blurb_mcq: One right answer. Words or pictures, any number of options.
item_blurb_mrq: Several right answers. Pupils are told how many to pick.
item_blurb_true_false: One statement. True / False, Betul / Salah, Ya / Tidak.
item_blurb_tick_table: Several rows, each ticked under one of the columns you name: True and False, or more.
item_blurb_pick_words: Underline or circle the right words in a sentence.
item_blurb_cloze: Blanks in a text: typed, from a word bank, or a choice at each blank.
item_blurb_short_answer: A word or a phrase, checked against the answers you accept.
item_blurb_word_completion: Spell a word from a clue, one box a letter.
item_blurb_numeric: A number, fraction, ratio, amount of money, time or measure.
item_blurb_matching: Join pairs with lines. Extra answers can be left over.
item_blurb_ordering: Put words or pictures in the right order.
item_blurb_rearrange: Put shuffled words back into a sentence.
item_blurb_classify: Sort words or pictures into groups.
item_blurb_label_picture: Name the numbered parts of a diagram, chart or map.
item_marking_mrq: Part marks: a share of the mark for each right pick, less one share for each wrong pick.
item_marking_tick_table: Part marks: a share of the mark for each row ticked correctly.
item_marking_pick_words: Part marks: a share of the mark for each right word, less one share for each wrong pick.
item_marking_cloze: Part marks: a share of the mark for each blank.
item_marking_numeric: Marked right or wrong: the answer must have the same value, written in this form.
item_marking_matching: Part marks: a share of the mark for each right pair.
item_marking_ordering: Part marks: a share of the mark for each item in its right place.
item_marking_rearrange: Marked right or wrong: the whole sentence must be in order.
item_marking_classify: Part marks: a share of the mark for each item in its right group.
item_marking_label_picture: Part marks: a share of the mark for each right label.
item_invalid: This question could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
item_text_unstorable: This holds a character that cannot be saved. Delete it and type it again.
item_text_too_long: Keep this to {max} characters or fewer.
item_list_too_long: This list holds up to {max}. Remove some.
item_option_empty: Give this option some words or a picture.
item_option_repeated: This option is the same as another one.
item_mrq_two_correct: Mark at least two right answers. For one right answer, use Multiple Choice.
item_mrq_all_correct: Leave at least one option that is not a right answer.
item_true_false_words_same: The two answer words must be different.
item_columns_count: A tick table has two to five columns.
item_column_repeated: This column has the same name as another one.
item_row_repeated: This row is the same as another one.
item_row_column_required: Choose the right column for this row.
item_sentence_too_short: Write a sentence of at least two words.
item_pick_words_none_correct: Tap at least one word that is an answer.
item_pick_words_all_correct: Leave at least one word that is not an answer.
item_cloze_blanks_required: Make at least one blank in the text.
item_cloze_blank_unanswered: Blank {n} in the text has no answer.
item_cloze_blank_repeated: Blank {n} is in the text more than once.
item_cloze_blank_unplaced: Blank {n} is not in the text.
item_cloze_choices_count: Give this blank two to four different choices.
item_cloze_choices_answer: This blank's answer must be one of its choices.
item_cloze_reuse_required: Two blanks have the same answer, so a word must be allowed more than once.
item_short_answer_required: Add at least one accepted answer.
item_word_invalid: The answer must be one word of 2 to 30 letters, with no spaces.
item_number_required: Enter the answer as a number.
item_tolerance_invalid: The tolerance must be 0 or more.
item_whole_number_required: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
item_denominator_invalid: The denominator must be a whole number, 1 or more.
item_ratio_terms: A ratio has two or three terms.
item_hour_12_invalid: With a.m. or p.m., the hour goes from 1 to 12.
item_hour_24_invalid: On the 24-hour clock, the hour goes from 0 to 23.
item_pair_required: Choose the answer that goes with this item.
item_entry_empty: Give this item some words or a picture.
item_entry_repeated: This item is the same as another one.
item_answer_empty: Give this answer some words or a picture.
item_answer_repeated: This answer is the same as another one.
item_groups_count: Classify needs two to four groups.
item_group_repeated: This group has the same name as another one.
item_classify_too_few: Add at least two items to sort.
item_classify_group_required: Put this item in a group.
item_labels_required: Place at least one label on the picture.
practice_label_picture_place: Place a label on the picture
practice_label_picture_hint: Click the picture to place a label; drag a label to move it.
practice_label_picture_keys: The arrow keys move the label, and further with Shift. Delete removes it.
practice_label_picture_labels_empty: Labels appear here as you place them.
practice_true_false_words_hint: The two words pupils choose between, in the language of the question.
practice_tick_table_columns_hint: Two to five, named as you like: True and False, or more. Pupils tick one column in each row.
practice_tick_table_rows_hint: Each row, and the column that is right for it.
practice_pick_words_hint: Tap every word that is an answer.
practice_pick_words_empty: Write the sentence, and its words appear here.
practice_matching_pairs_hint: Each row is one right pair. An item can be words or a picture.
practice_matching_right_image: Picture for the answer for item {n}
practice_matching_shared_hint: To let one answer serve two items, write it the same in both rows.
practice_matching_extras_hint: Shown on the right with no partner.
practice_ordering_hint: Pupils see them shuffled. An item can be words or a picture.
practice_rearrange_chips_hint: Cut at the spaces. Join two chips or split one, for a phrase or for a language written without spaces.
practice_rearrange_chips_empty: The chips appear here as you write the sentence.
practice_rearrange_chips_help: Select a chip to join it to the one beside it, or to split it between two letters.
practice_classify_hint: Two to four groups. An item can be words or a picture.
item_matching_hint: Draw a line from an item to its answer, or tap the item and then its answer.
item_rearrange_hint: Tap the words in order. Tap a placed word to take it back.
practice_cloze_text_placeholder: Write the text whole, with every answer in it.
practice_cloze_text_hint: Select a word, then Make Blank. The word becomes that blank's answer.
practice_cloze_accepted_hint: Add every spelling you accept for a blank.
practice_cloze_bank_hint: The answers, plus any extra words you add to make pupils think.
practice_cloze_reuse: A word can be used more than once
practice_cloze_choices_hint: Two to four choices a blank. The first is the answer.
practice_word_completion_hint: Pupils get one box for each letter.
practice_numeric_number_hint: Whole numbers and decimals. A tolerance of 0 means the exact value.
practice_numeric_equal_fractions_example: Also accept equal fractions, such as {example}
practice_numeric_equal_ratios_example: Also accept equal ratios, such as {example}
practice_numeric_money_hint: A pupil’s 19.2, 19.20 and RM19.20 are read as the same amount; so are 1500 and 1 500.
practice_numeric_time_hint: A pupil’s 5.50 p.m., 5:50 p.m. and 17:50 are read as the same time.
practice_import_description: Into {stage}, after the questions already there.
practice_import_note_sheets: The template has one sheet for each question type, with a sample row, and a sheet for passages.
practice_import_note_passages: A question joins a passage by the passage’s code.
practice_import_note_pictures: A picture goes in the Picture cell of its question, or in the cell of the option or item it shows. Label a Picture has no sheet: it is made here.
practice_import_left_out: Rows to fix are left out, and so is a question that the stage already has or that the file asks twice. Fix the rows in the file and import it again, or add those questions here.
practice_import_done_none: Nothing was added: these questions are already in the stage.
practice_import_not_xlsx: Choose an Excel workbook: a file that ends in .xlsx.
practice_import_too_large: Without its pictures, this file is larger than 2 MB. Split it into smaller files.
practice_import_file_too_large: This file is larger than 100 MB. Split it into smaller files.
practice_import_unreadable: This file could not be read as an Excel workbook. Save it as .xlsx in Excel and choose it again.
practice_import_no_sheets: This file has none of the template’s sheets. Use Download Template and fill that file in.
practice_import_empty: This file has no questions yet. Use Download Template, add your questions under the example rows, and choose the file again.
practice_import_too_many: This file has {count} questions. One file holds up to {max}, so split it.
practice_import_stale: This review can no longer be imported. Choose the file again.
practice_import_failed: The import did not go through and nothing was added. Try again.
practice_import_picture_failed: A picture could not be uploaded, so nothing was added. Try again.
practice_import_missing_column: This sheet has no “{column}” column. Copy the header row from the template.
practice_import_date_cell: Excel has turned this cell into a date. Format the cell as Text and type it again.
practice_import_picture_words: This cell takes a picture and no words. Place the picture in it.
practice_import_picture_misplaced: A picture is in this cell, which takes none. Move it to the cell it belongs to, such as Picture.
practice_import_picture_outside: A picture in this row is outside the sheet’s columns. Move it to the cell it belongs to.
practice_import_picture_header: A picture is over the header row. Move it down into the row of its question.
practice_import_picture_two: This cell has more than one picture. Keep one.
practice_import_picture_unusable: The picture in this cell cannot be used. Replace it with a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF of 4 MB or less.
practice_import_difficulty: Write Low, Medium or High, or leave it empty for Medium.
practice_import_answer_letter: Write the letter of the one right option, such as B.
practice_import_answer_letters: Write the letters of the right options, such as A, C.
practice_import_not_a_column: “{value}” is not one of the columns.
practice_import_pick_words_brackets: Put [square brackets] around each word that is an answer.
practice_import_cloze_mode: Write Typing, Word Bank or Choices, or leave it empty for Typing.
practice_import_cloze_extra: Extra words go with Word Bank only.
practice_import_numeric_form: Write Number, Fraction, Mixed Number, Ratio, Money, Time or Measure.
practice_import_numeric_unused: A {form} answer does not use this column. Leave it empty.
practice_import_not_fraction: “{value}” is not a fraction. Write it like 3/4.
practice_import_not_mixed: “{value}” is not a mixed number. Write it like 2 1/2.
practice_import_not_ratio: “{value}” is not a ratio. Write it like 3:4.
practice_import_not_time: “{value}” is not a time. Write it like 7:30 am, or 19:30.
practice_import_not_measure: “{value}” is not a measure in two units. Write it like 2 kg 500 g.
practice_import_passage_unknown: No passage on the Passages sheet has the code “{code}”.
practice_import_passage_broken: The passage “{code}” has to be fixed first. See the Passages sheet.
practice_import_code_repeated: An earlier passage already has the code “{code}”.
run_answers_after: Answers and tips come after the last question.
run_unanswered_description: You can go back and answer, or finish now and get no marks for what is left out.
run_map_hint: Tap a number to go to that question.
stars_none_description: Each time you finish this stage, your score shows here.

match.countPlural=one: {count} more mark for the next star.
match.countPlural=other: {count} more marks for the next star.

practice_none_description: This classroom’s subject has no stages with questions yet.
item_classify_hint: Drag each item into its group, or tap an item and then the name of its group. Tap an item in a group, or drag it back out, to take it back.
progress_key: Each bar is the class, by each student’s best:
progress_tally: {three} with three stars, {two} with two, {one} with one, {none} with none, {unpractised} not practised
assignment_due_hint: A student can still finish it after this date. It is then marked late.
assignment_due_past: Choose today or a later date.
assignment_none_teacher: Open a stage on the Practice tab to assign it to the whole class or to chosen students.
assignment_none_student: Your teacher has not assigned anything here yet. You can practise any stage on the Practice tab.
assignment_delete_description: “{stage}” comes off the students’ lists, and its notifications go with it. The practice they have done stays.
notifications_none_description: When a student finishes something you assigned, it shows here.
